beats.text: Do not scale your next training run before you see how vLLM delivers 24x.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing GPU die with flickering red gaps representing wasted VRAM.

beats.text: The villain is the KV cache. It demands contiguous memory blocks, leaving your VRAM looking like a Swiss cheese of wasted space.
beats.visual_focus: A rigid, segmented memory map showing massive empty gaps between allocated blocks.

beats.text: Enter PagedAttention. It shatters the rigid requirement by treating GPU memory like an operating system treats virtual RAM.
beats.visual_focus: Blocks of memory being rearranged dynamically into non-contiguous slots.
